title: I built a flight 3D Snake game with Codex + Playgama MCP — here are my early playtest numbers
author: Wide-Island-5744
selftext:
I wanted to see what classic Snake would feel like if you could fly in any direction

I used Codex to build and iterate on the game in JavaScript/Three.js, and Playgama MCP to upload builds and publish a playable version for testing. The cover art is AI-generated, using the actual game model as a reference.

Here’s what the early Playgama dashboard shows – average play time on September 19:

* **Desktop: 9m 12s**
* **Android: 14m 49s**

It’s a small sample, but pretty impressive numbers. What do you think?

comments.author: Romeowns
comments.body: For arrow controls, you need to add an option to invert Y axis. Pressing up to go up is weird in a flight game context.
